query:

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscription_charges) AS total_charges,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions) AS total_subscriptions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allowed_clients WHERE is_active = 1) AS total_clients,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excluded_asaas_charges) AS total_excluded,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unclassified_charges) AS total_unclassified;
